description: Change the signed-in member's Heed profile: declared tax residency, citizenships, the countries they spend time in, income types, asset classes, wealth bracket, the situations on their horizon, crypto mode, and the residency goal per country (establish or avoid, with an optional custom threshold). Use it when the member says something like 'I now live in Lisbon', 'I sold my crypto' or 'track Spain for me'. Partial: send only what changes. Values come from Heed's own lists (the tool names them when one does not fit). This changes their real record, so repeat the change in words and get a yes before calling. Returns the whole position after the write.

asset_classes.description: From: Equities/stocks, Crypto, Real estate, Business equity, Funds/ETFs, Bonds/fixed income, Pensions/retirement, Precious metals, Art & collectibles, Cash/FX. Replaces the list.

citizenships.description: Every citizenship held, country names or codes. Replaces the list.

countries_tracked.description: Countries the member spends time in. Replaces the list.

crypto_holder.description: Whether the member holds crypto (switches the dashboard's crypto mode).

household.description: single, married or partner_unmarried (a partner the member is not married to); null to clear. Family and dependant visa routes usually need a legal marriage.

income_types.description: From: Employment salary, Freelance/consulting, Dividends, Capital gains, Crypto trading/staking, Rental income. Replaces the list.

residency_goals.description: The goal per country; each entry replaces that country's setting.

custom_threshold.description: The member's own day threshold for that country, or null to use the country's rule.

goal.description: establish: the member wants to be resident there; avoid: they want to stay under the line.

situations_on_the_horizon.description: From: Relocating, Business exit, Crypto disposal, Inheritance, Property sale, Not yet. Replaces the list.

tax_residency.description: Declared tax residency, country name or code; null to clear.

wealth_bracket.description: Under $100K, $100K to $500K, $500K to $2M, $2M to $5M or $5M+; null to clear.

name: update_my_position
